## File layout

| container | format | reader | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disc image` | GameCube FST; game code is shared/mgso.rel (REL, MGS2 engine port), main.dol = SDK + loader | gbox/gcdisc.py (dol_rel_to_elf links the REL at 0x80300000 for Ghidra) |  |
| `stage.dat` | header {.., u16 count} + {name[8], u32 sector}; stage = rows + zlib pages (level 6) with file rows {type<<24\|strcode, offset}; 114 / 117 stages | gbox/ts_stage.py | stages back to back, 0 slack; writer recompresses at level 9 into the same span |
| `.kms models (type 0x0a) / .tri texture sets (type 0x13)` | kms BE, 21-bone MGS2 skeleton for gameplay models (53 for cut-scene); tri = entries + embedded TPL (C4/C8/CMPR/RGBA8) | gbox/ts_kms.py, gbox/ts_tex.py, gbox/twin_snakes.py | strcode 24-bit hash: snake_def 0xf7a622, sna_def 0x413aa8, out_cold 0x26e012 |
| `shared/face.dat (codec), demo.dat (cut-scene packets), movie.dat` | face.dat raw pages, one stage per call setup, .tri set per speaker (104x178 CMPR portraits + patches) | gbox/ts_stage.py, gbox/twin_snakes_cast.py | demo.dat holds no models |

## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** live_use: build mod, server session swap (save state -> mod on same worker -> load state), then twin_snakes_live op=apply. stage.dat keeps size/offset so the FST does not move; unverified in Dolphin.

**Pick whip: partial.** resolve_slot: target words (Snake/soldier/cast name), then models the stage has in RAM, then screen point (centre = Snake); live_use writes the swap. Implemented, never run on a live game.

**Live controls:** twin_snakes_live session tool (op=loaded, op=apply: paused writes, readback, restore on failure). No inventory controls (Action Replay candidates not validated).

### RAM / runtime hooks (curated)

| hook | address | what | status | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| loaded .kms / .tri scan | `MEM1 0x80000000-0x81800000 (scan)` | paused 1 MiB-chunk scan for TPL magic 0x0020AF30 sets and relocated .kms headers with cast strcodes (find_loaded / find_sets); no fixed addresses | unverified | gbox/twin_snakes_live.py, gbox/twin_snakes_swap.py |
| kms loader / relocation | `0x806b66b4 / 0x806b6be8 / 0x806b6860` | mgso.rel loaders that make header +0x5c and array offsets absolute (addresses at the 0x80300000 Ghidra link base) | unverified | docs/twin_snakes.md |
| draw loop / model object | `0x806a2a6c / 0x806a7860` | draw loop reads parts/strips/arrays every frame, so an in-place body write shows next frame if mesh records stay put | unverified | docs/twin_snakes.md, gbox/twin_snakes_live.py |
| actor model choice | `0x80364d78 / ~0x803df590` | Snake actor init (model snake_def) / soldier model switch by strcode | unverified | docs/twin_snakes.md |

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- Neither the disc swap nor the live RAM apply has been seen in Dolphin; loaded-copy layout comes from the decompile, not a RAM dump
- Dolphin may keep the old texture cached until texel hashes are re-checked
- REL runtime load address not recorded; every live step needs a paused 24 MiB MEM1 scan over the GDB stub
- Prerecorded movies, .cv2 models, radar/item icons and codec name tags are not written
